title: Rescue the Weak and Needy

questions.question: God has taken his place in the divine council; in the midst of the gods he holds what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 82:1 (ESV): "God has taken his place in the divine council; in the midst of the gods he holds judgment:"

questions.question: How long will you judge unjustly and show partiality to the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 82:2 (ESV): "How long will you judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked?"

questions.question: Give justice to the weak and the whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 82:3 (ESV): "Give justice to the weak and the fatherless;"

questions.question: Maintain the right of the afflicted and the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 82:3 (ESV): "maintain the right of the afflicted and the destitute."

questions.question: Rescue the weak and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 82:4 (ESV): "Rescue the weak and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked."

questions.question: They have neither knowledge nor understanding, they walk about in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 82:5 (ESV): "They have neither knowledge nor understanding, they walk about in darkness;"

questions.question: All the foundations of the earth are what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 82:5 (ESV): "...all the foundations of the earth are shaken."

questions.question: I said, "You are gods, sons of the Most High, all of whom?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 82:6 (ESV): "I said, 'You are gods, sons of the Most High, all of you;'"

questions.question: Nevertheless, like men you shall do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 82:7 (ESV): "nevertheless, like men you shall die,"

questions.question: Arise, O God, judge the earth; for you shall inherit all the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 82:8 (ESV): "Arise, O God, judge the earth; for you shall inherit all the nations!"

questions.question: This Psalm is a Psalm of whom?
What does God hold in the midst of the gods?
questions.explanation: Psalm 82:1 (ESV): "...in the midst of the gods he holds judgment:"

questions.question: Who walks about in darkness?
questions.explanation: Psalm 82:5 (ESV): "They have neither knowledge nor understanding, they walk about in darkness;"

questions.question: Selah is mentioned how many times in Psalm 82?

key_verse_text: Give justice to the weak and the fatherless; maintain the right of the afflicted and the destitute. Rescue the weak and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked.
